verdict.rationale: Windows ships broad hardware/driver compatibility (most Windows 10 apps/devices work on Windows 11) letting power-users pick arbitrary hardware, but community evidence documents concrete vendor lock-in: recent Windows setup effectively forces a Microsoft Account (with workarounds needed to get a local account), mandatory telemetry and forced updates, contradicting the 'without vendor lock-in' part of the story. missing for 10: evidence of unrestricted OS installation without any account/telemetry requirement, first-party acknowledgment of local-account-only installs, and independent corroboration of full hardware freedom without ecosystem lock-in.
